tm.identica_1: Ashtanga is a very dynamic and athletic form of hatha yoga, made up of six series or levels, with a fixed order of postures.
tm.identica_2: Usually, students begin an Ashtanga practice with five repetitions of Sun Salutation A and Sun Salutation B.
tm.identica_3: It is rooted in vinyasa, the flowing movements between postures, with a focus on energy and breath.
tm.antonimo: Ashtanga is a very slow and gentle form of restorative yoga, with no fixed order of postures.
tm.casi_1: Ashtanga is a very dynamic and athletic style of hatha yoga, made up of six series, with a fixed order of postures.
tm.casi_2: Students usually begin their Ashtanga practice with five repetitions of Sun Salutation A and B.
tm.parafrasis_1: New practitioners typically start their Ashtanga sessions by performing Sun Salutation A and B five times each.

glos.aprobado_1: Practice each posture (asana) with close attention to breath control (pranayama).
glos.aprobado_2: Meditation (dhyana) gradually leads toward oneness with the self (samadhi).
glos.aprobado_3: Self-discipline (niyama) and moral codes (yama) form the ethical foundation of yoga.
glos.prohibido_1: The eight extremities of yoga must be mastered one by one before progressing.
glos.prohibido_2: This yoga hatha sequence focuses on strength and endurance.
glos.prohibido_3: Achieving unicidad con uno mismo is the ultimate goal of the practice.

seg.parrafo_largo: Ashtanga es una forma muy dinámica y atlética de hatha yoga, compuesta por seis series o niveles, con un orden fijo de posturas. Tiene sus raíces en el vinyasa, los movimientos fluidos entre posturas, con un enfoque en la energía y la respiración. Si bien es una práctica muy física, también promueve la claridad mental y la paz interior. Los alumnos avanzan progresivamente de una serie a otra únicamente cuando el instructor considera que han dominado la anterior.
